# Hydra Sync 1.9.1

Wording cleanup around **Undo playtime changes…** — no behaviour change.

## What's new

Nothing functional: this release only removes wording that referred to builds which are no
longer available, so the docs and the in-app messages describe today's behaviour only.

- The **Undo playtime changes…** confirmation dialog no longer mentions older plugin builds.
  It now says what undo does and what happens next: playtime is restored, achievements are
  untouched, and the next sync applies the replace-if-larger rule again from a clean slate.
- The README no longer references the old additive builds that could double playtime. Undo is
  documented as what it is — a way to put a game's playtime back after a sync.
- Undo's behaviour is unchanged. Games whose pre-sync value was recorded come back exactly; in
  the rare case where no original was recorded, the value is recovered from how much the plugin
  added and the completion notification labels those games as approximate.

## Upgrade notes

None. Install it if you prefer the new wording; if you never open the undo dialog or the README,
1.9.0 behaves identically.

## Install

1. Download `HydraSync-1.9.1.pext` from the [Releases page](https://github.com/cometmcisaac/hydra-playnite-sync/releases).
2. Double-click it and confirm the update in Playnite, or extract the contents into
   `%APPDATA%\Playnite\Extensions\A76358E9-BFA2-4189-B6F3-2307EA4E217B\`.
3. Restart Playnite.

Settings live under **Add-ons → Extensions settings → Generic → Hydra Sync**.
